items.value: OV9281 1280x800 global-shutter MIPI sensor, bare CSP
items.hard: Bare CSP is not sold at catalog distributors; needs an OmniVision distributor quote (GoPhotonics RFQ, Arrow/Avnet quoted channel, or Chinese agents). Assembly needs a CSP-capable specialist; ball pitch/pad in design.py is ASSUMED 0.5/0.25 mm - verify. Fallback: buy a ready OV9281 module (e.g. Camemake CM-MIPI-OV9281-Universal on DigiKey https://www.digikey.co.uk/en/products/detail/camemake/CM-MIPI-OV9281-Universal/27525168 ) and re-spin around a connector.
items.notes: QUOTE-ONLY: no price found for the bare CSP (link is a quote-request listing). RFQ route: GoPhotonics quote form (link), or OmniVision authorised distributors (Arrow/Avnet/WPG) for a CSP/reel quote; expect MOQ and possibly NRE.

items.value: M12 lens, f=1.92 mm, 90 deg HFOV (1/4in sensor), low distortion
items.hard: Exact 1.92 mm / 90 deg HFOV lens is hard to find. Closest catalog match seen: Arducam M40210M09S 2.1 mm M12 (https://iot-store.com.au/products/m40210m09s-arducam-m12-camera-lens, price not read). Kurokesu sells 2.1 mm M12 lenses (~EUR 37-42, not counted). Re-check housing cone clearance if focal length changes.
items.notes: QUOTE-ONLY: exact 1.92 mm / 90 deg HFOV M12 lens has no catalog price. Suggested RFQ vendors: Commonlands (https://commonlands.com), Sunex, Arducam; closest catalog 2.1 mm M12 is Arducam M40210M09S. Mono OV9281 is NIR-sensitive: pick a lens without a visible-only IR-cut if using IR illumination.
